description:
Validate vault files against the schemas.

Usage: lint [PATH ...] [--quiet] [--schemas DIR]

Args:
  PATH  files to validate; repeatable. With no paths, the whole vault is checked.

Flags:
  --quiet         no per-violation output; report by exit code only
  --schemas DIR   schemas directory (default: the schemas bundled with the package)

Examples:
  []
  ["--quiet"]
  ["notes/2026-09-10-14-30-00.md"]

Notes:
  Read-only. Violations print as <absolute path>:<line>: <message>.
  Reports files that are not valid UTF-8 as 'file is not valid UTF-8'. Other commands skip such files silently.
  Exit 0: clean. Exit 1: violations found. Exit 2: no schemas loaded.
